version.note: The source identifies the fourth movement, not a particular performing edition. No score collation or cut-by-cut comparison has been made.

performers.note: The attribution is stated in the file description and embedded metadata. Individual orchestral personnel are not documented.

place.note: The source does not identify a live audience or concert; neither is inferred from the venue.

catalogue.note: A transferred issue is identified, not a verified first-publication year.

matrixTakeSides.note: Commons supplies this range without assigning individual numbers or takes to the finale. It is retained as source-reported album identification, not a verified finale-side matrix list.

credits.note: No transfer engineer is identified; an uploader is not automatically the engineer.

processing.note: The revision comment criticises processing on the superseded file. This documents an uploader’s statement, not an independent restoration analysis; no engineer, transfer date or processing settings are established. The linked upstream archive is unavailable.

composition.note: The composition notice identifies Tchaikovsky’s death in 1893; it is not the recording licence.

recording.note: Programme rule 1 accepts this recording-specific European expiry statement; US status is not established.
